dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR and CWKS remain independent. MTLC-02 may consume their published/current contracts only as explicit dependencies and may not mutate their lane scope.

scope.name: Campaign Lounge and Group Communication
scope.responsibility: Give every campaign a persistent communication home with chat, channels, threads, announcements, polls, files, private spaces, search, notification controls, and portable campaign history connected to Multiversal objects.
exit_criteria: Routine campaign communication can occur inside Multiversal.
Messages and attachments can be linked or converted into relevant campaign objects.
Notification controls prevent communication features from becoming disruptive.
Communication history participates in governed offline/reconnect, backup, export, privacy, and provider-exit behavior.

next_action: Await the owner's MTLC-03 execution instruction before implementation.
